item.title: Baby DONT Cry’s rapid rise continues as P NATION pushes its first girl group forward
item.description: While K-pop has gained global interest in the last decade, one name in the industry, PSY, is bringing a new girl group onto the scene.

item.title: Jarran Reed, Julian Love set to return to lineup for Seattle Seahawks
item.description: Nose tackle Jarran Reed and safety Julian Love are set to return to the lineup for the Seattle Seahawks this Sunday against the Atlanta Falcons.

item.title: Renton, WA police arrest man wanted for ramming stolen car into patrol vehicles
item.description: The search for a suspected car thief, allegedly high on fentanyl, came to a dramatic end in Renton.

item.title: Seattle Mariners finalize coaching staff for 2026 season
item.description: The Seattle Mariners made three additions to their coaching staff – including former catcher Austin Nola – to round out their coaching staff for the 2026 season.

item.title: Jimmy Rogers leaves Washington State to become Iowa State head coach
item.description: The Washington State Cougars will be looking for another new head football coach after Jimmy Rogers left the program to take the head coaching job at Iowa State on Friday night.

item.title: Rivers expected to flood in Skagit, Snohomish, and King counties
item.description: Heavy rainfall over the next week is expected to bring flooding to Snohomish, King and Skagit counties and officials want communities to prepare now.

item.title: 14-year-old shot in car in Tacoma, WA, hospitalized in critical condition
item.description: Tacoma police are investigating after a 14-year-old boy was found shot in a car and later hospitalized in critical condition Friday afternoon.

item.title: Seattle police release bodycam video in fatal shooting of armed man
item.description: Newly released bodycam video shows the moments that led up to Seattle police officers shooting and killing an armed man in the Rainier Valley neighborhood.

item.title: Kirkland, WA suspect arrested after recent bank robberies
item.description: Zachary Thomas, 31, is charged in a robbery and attempted robbery at two Kirkland banks, allegedly using a Lyft to flee in one of the crimes.

item.title: Showers, breezy weather in Seattle this weekend, heavy mountain snow Saturday
item.description: We are tracking more rain, mountain snow and continuing strong winds in western Washington this weekend.
